summary: Land acquisition compensation dispute for Express Highway Phase VII project; market value determination for urbanized agricultural land; conflict on applicability of floor rates vs. sale exemplars; Reference Court's Rs.22,00,754/acre vs. High Court's reduced Rs.14,52,010/acre; deduction of 35% development charges challenged; small land sale exemplars admissible under Atma Singh ruling; High Court error in relying solely on floor rates circular despite available evidence; remand in Surender Singh case ignored by High Court; land losers argue urban non-agricultural potential warrants higher valuation.
final_judgment: High Court judgment set aside; Reference Court award reinstated at Rs.22,00,754 per acre; compensation restored without 35% deduction for development charges.
